label: Default — the poultice and the provenance

recentEvents.value: Watched him on the Glass walk through the fen's mallow beds calling them corruption — the beds her salves come from.
Treated his cuts anyway. Healing him while telling him the provenance is her form of protest.

unresolvedConflicts.value: He is courteous to her, grateful for the poultices, and trampling the garden they came from.

temporaryObjective.value: Heal him, and name the people who grew the medicine, every time.

notes: Her craft descends from the fen's herbalists (profile notes); the no-poisons boundary should gate any later vendor logic.
